name: Transport Corporation of India Ltd

ledger.quote: The two ships that we'd ordered are scheduled to come between July, August next year, which will essentially feature in FY27.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.target: Take delivery of two ordered ships
ledger.verdict: Management affirmed new ships arrival next year.

ledger.quote: In terms of the future outlook, we're looking at a 10 to 12% growth on the top line and bottom line this year, slightly subdued compared to last year.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.topic: Revenue and bottom line growth guidance
ledger.target: 10 to 12% top line and bottom line growth
ledger.verdict: Management restated guidance at 10 to 12% for FY27.

ledger.quote: This year's budget about 400, 450 crores with almost a similar line, except that the shipping, we'll have to make two payments this year versus one.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.verdict: Management guided for 450-500 crores capex for the next financial year.

ledger.quote: In branches we opened 40 new branches we intend to open 50 new branches this year.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.verdict: Management promised to open 50 new branches this year, but the latest call lacks branch count updates.
ledger.evidence: No mention of branch counts in the latest call transcript.

ledger.quote: And that would, maybe another 100-200 trucks will get net added.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.verdict: Management promised a net addition of 100-200 trucks, but the latest call gives no truck count figures.
ledger.evidence: No truck addition data provided in the call.

ledger.quote: we should start seeing some normalization. If the conflict in different parts of the world start reducing, we should see the freight prices coming down
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agrawal
ledger.verdict: Management discussed potential normalization of freight prices without a timeline, leaving no concrete verification.
ledger.evidence: Freight price normalization remains subject to geopolitical conditions.

ledger.quote: So, at a console level, it is about 8%. So, we should hit 12%, 10-12% in that because our Concor business is also growing.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management guided for 10-12% console level growth and 15% bottom line growth.

ledger.quote: In terms of our guidance of 10 to 12% on the top line, about 10 to 15% on the bottom line at a console level with stats.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management targeted 10-15% bottom line growth for FY26; FY26 PAT came in at 460.0 crore.

ledger.quote: So, in the next year onwards, we should see that inching up starting with 100 basis points, etc., type of improvement.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management guided for 100 bps margin improvement starting next year.
ledger.evidence: Margin improvement target is set for subsequent periods.

ledger.quote: We have ordered two rakes also, which will come sometime end of next year.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management promised delivery of two rakes by end of next year.

ledger.quote: Profitability is muted, but I think this is expected for the next few quarters.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management noted muted profitability expected for the next few quarters.
ledger.evidence: Profitability trends remain monitored across ongoing quarters.

ledger.quote: So, I think we'll remain at 30-ish percent even after that.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management targeted 30 to 40 percent EBIT margin for full FY27.

ledger.quote: Net-net, I think we should be able to maintain this 15%.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management anticipated 15% growth in the supply chain business for FY27.

ledger.quote: So, we are quite hopeful that this will start, in terms of some of the changes that we've made in the system, we should start reflecting in the numbers going forward.
ledger.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
ledger.verdict: Management stated freight business numbers should reflect changes in the next two quarters.

open.quote: So, the guidance for this year, as we have indicated, about 10-12% on the top line should also apply to this business, and our profitability should improve from the last year.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal

open.quote: So, again, I think this business should grow in the higher teens, 12-15% for the top line.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
open.topic: Supply chain business top line growth

open.quote: The new ship is expected in September end of this year, the next two months.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
open.target: Induct new ship by end of September

open.quote: So, yes, I think we are quite confident from the pipeline perspective that we should be able to get to that 12% growth for the quarter, for the year.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal

open.quote: So, once they start coming in from the first quarter three, beginning of quarter three, we should see improvement.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal
open.target: Improvement in beginning of quarter three

open.quote: Full year is 12-15% is what we are maintaining. I think some of that we'll start seeing in the next few months.
open.speaker: Mr. Vineet Agarwal

read: Management often shifts guidance targets and frequently leaves specific operational metrics unquantified. Past revenue and PAT growth targets were missed or restated across multiple periods.
questions: Why did revenue growth miss the 10-12% target in FY25?
What is the exact net addition of trucks achieved this year against your prior promise?
How many new branches have been opened to date against the 50 branches target?
bull: Consolidated revenue reached 4917.0 crore in FY26.
PAT grew to 460.0 crore in FY26.
bear: Growth targets for top line and bottom line have repeatedly missed prior guidance.
Bunker pricing volatility continues to exert pressure on seaways margins.
Supply chain business growth has slowed down in recent quarters.
